tests.name: test_ac1_overdue_with_a_malformed_stored_due_names_the_task
tests.scenario: Open task 1 with due "soon"; list --overdue with TASKLIST_TODAY unset and with 2026-10-01 (parametrized): exit 2, empty stdout, one stderr line with the id and "soon", no TASKLIST_TODAY, no exception escaping main(). The invalid-TASKLIST_TODAY guard case is covered by the existing test_ac5_today_comes_from_the_environment_and_a_bad_value_is_an_error.

stub_check.detail: 2 failed, 38 passed: both parametrized cases of the new test fail on assertions against today's code; the invalid-TASKLIST_TODAY guard is covered by existing test_ac5, which passes.
